_readme: Mainnet Config for 23-initialize.js, filled with the defaults the user accepted ('use defaults' to every line of refs/mainnet/user-decisions.md, 2026-10-06; values from refs/mainnet/fix-plan.md section 6.1). Copy to mainnet-config.json (same folder) on the setup machine and replace every REPLACE_ value with the public keys 10-keys.sh prints and your Squads addresses. Amounts are lamports (1 SOL = 1000000000) as strings. sol_usd_e6 'auto' takes the live Pyth price at initialize (the field is unused while price_source is 1, Pyth). The top-level fields go into initialize; the 'setup' block is applied by the setup transactions that follow it once the upgraded program is deployed (observers, collection, the new Config fields).
treasury: REPLACE_WITH_TREASURY_ADDRESS (decision D4: VAULT #1 of the settings multisig, not the multisig account Squads shows first; it must already hold >= 0.00065024 SOL; the scripts refuse anything else)

setup._readme: Applied after initialize (fix-plan 4.6, 23-initialize.js on the upgraded program): set_observers, init_collection, then update_tier_config(tier_guard 1) with set_config_ext(mask 15). Roles: 1 COUNT, 2 CAP, 4 PAUSE (crank and standby 3 = count + cap; watcher 6 = cap + pause, never count).

observers.pubkey: REPLACE_WITH_CRANK_PUBKEY (10-keys.sh; the Worker's CRANK_SECRET_KEY, set by you with 30-worker-secrets.sh)
REPLACE_WITH_WATCHER_PUBKEY (10-keys.sh; the watcher Worker's key, set by you with 30-worker-secrets.sh)

setup.admin_multisig: REPLACE_WITH_SETTINGS_MULTISIG_ADDRESS (decision D4: the Squads multisig S itself, not a vault; the scripts check that the treasury above is its vault #1)
